verdict.rationale: Better Stack's marketing says you can 'plug in' Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus and AWS (docs-27), and its pricing page lists importing Grafana and Datadog dashboards (docs-72), so three of the five named tools have first-party integration claims. These are one-line marketing mentions without setup documentation, CloudWatch appears only under generic 'AWS', and Sentry is not mentioned at all. Missing for 10: documented setup guides for each integration, explicit CloudWatch integration, any Sentry integration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
